bullets.text: Nokia Surpasses Profit Expectations - **Nokia** reports strong Q3 profits driven by optical and cloud services, despite market challenges.
Europe's Space Industry Unites - **Airbus**, **Leonardo**, and **Thales** merge to enhance competitiveness in the space sector.
Digital Twins Revolutionising Tower Management - Digital twin technology enhances safety and efficiency for tower operators.
Vodafone Automates 5G Operations - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to develop AI tools for efficient 5G network management.
PSTN Switch-Off Approaches - UK businesses must transition to all-IP networks by January 2027 to avoid operational risks.
Amigo Mesh Network for Protesters - New mesh network technology aims to keep political protesters connected during blackouts.
Vodafone Plans Black Sea Cable - **Vodafone** announces a new submarine cable to enhance connectivity in the Black Sea region.
Private 5G Reshaping Industries - Organizations increasingly adopt private 5G for enhanced connectivity in mission-critical operations.
T-Mobile US Achieves Record Growth - **T-Mobile US** reports record customer additions and raises full-year guidance amid rising capex.
Telefónica Eyes 1&1 Partnership - **Telefónica** explores renewed cooperation with **1&1** to strengthen competitiveness in Germany.
